messages:
amanda_sales: Hey team — Acme Health POC needs a billing project and hosted API keys today. They want PAYG trial credits + a hard spend cap/escrow on the project, and may request a dedicated pool behind a VPC next week for HIPAA-sensitive flows. Can someone outline the exact steps we need (and approvals) to provision the billing project, allocate credits, and lock a spend cap? Need this by EOD Friday.

jordan_se: Do they need Dedicated immediately or can we start hosted? Estimating demo traffic helps decide.

ryan_engineer: They can start on hosted. If they flip to Dedicated/VPC later we'll need network onboarding + VPC peering + access to customer subnet. For now list of must-haves: org billing project, service account with ephemeral API keys, KMS for encryption of PHI artifacts, and audit logging enabled.

mike_finops: Quick note on spend caps: we can't do a true "hard billing lock" at the cloud level, but we can enforce project-level quota + pre-funded credits + an internal escrow workflow to pause keys once threshold hit. Recommend: allocate trial credits (X USD), set token quota that approximates that amount, and enable support alerting at 80% usage. Example quota config we typically use: 
```json
{
  "project": "acme-health-poc",
  "monthly_credit_usd": "3000",
  "token_quota": "12000000",
  "alert_threshold_pct": "80",
  "auto-disable_on_threshold": "true"  // support flow pauses keys, not cloud billing
}
```

sara_cs: To create the project we need: customer billing contact, legal PO (if they want invoicing), and the admin email for service-account setup. Steps I can run: 1) Create trial org & project in Console, 2) Apply trial credits to project, 3) Set quota + alerting, 4) Generate ephemeral API key via support flow and attach roles. Expect ~2 business days if we have the admin email and approval.

amanda_sales: Customer details: acct: Acme Health, contact: lisa@acmehealth.com, use-case: clinical summarization for internal ops, est. 2M tokens/day for demo week (~6M tokens/week). They explicitly requested a hard spend cap/escrow.

jordan_se: Given 6M tokens/week, mike — is the quota above reasonable? Might need a higher short-term allotment for the demo. Also security will want the questionnaire filled before we enable PHI.

ryan_engineer: I'll start the VPC questionnaire and network intake tomorrow. For Dedicated gating plan: create dedicated pool with node isolation, set route policy to only accept requests from their project identity, and enforce KMS key ARN for model KV persistence. I'll share the exact onboarding checklist once I finish the intake.

mike_finops: Sounds good. For the escrow approach we log a manual trigger: at 100% alert we rotate the keys (ephemeral keys expire) and pause further provisioning. Support runs that rotation — need an ok from legal for escrow terms. @sara_cs could you kick off the support ticket and link the PO? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Provisioning request created: PR-8420 — https://internal.redwood/provision/PR-8420 (assigned to sara_cs, ryan_engineer)

sara_cs: Kicked off PR-8420. I requested lisa@acmehealth for admin email and added a checklist item for BAA & KMS ARN. ETA: 48 hours once we have admin email + signed DPA.

mike_finops: I'll prepare the trial-credit allocation and the quota thresholds. Please confirm final KMS key ARN and whether they want credits consumed first or quota-limited.

ryan_engineer: I'll follow up with Acme on the KMS ARN in the network intake. Will also attach the security questionnaire draft to this thread after review.

amanda_sales: Thanks all — I’ll get the admin email and signed DPA today and post it here. If we can push the spendcap + trial credits before EOD Friday that would unblock the demo. :pray:
